title: One reviewer's findings on one candidate

lens.description: The review lens this file answers for, e.g. security.

candidate.description: The commit reviewed. A findings file whose candidate is not the commit about to be merged is evidence about something else, and shipping refuses to count it.

summary.description: One or two sentences on what was examined and what was concluded. Written even when nothing was found.

findings.description: Empty means the lens ran and found nothing. A missing file means the lens did not run, which is not the same thing.

severity.description: blocking: must not merge. major: must not merge without a decision. minor and nit: recorded, never gating.

scope.description: Who answers the finding. pull-request when the remedy is a change to the pull request's text. history when the remedy is a change to the commits (a message, an author, how the change is split into commits) and not to any file. code otherwise, including a code defect that names no single file.

file.description: Repository-relative path, or null when the finding names no single file.

title.description: One line naming the defect, not its category.

detail.description: Concrete inputs or state that produce the wrong behaviour. A finding that cannot name how it fails is a preference, and belongs at nit.

fix.description: What to change, when that is obvious. Null when the right repair is a judgement call.

rulings.description: One entry per unfinished item this reader was given, ruled against the candidate under review. Empty when it was given none. An item with no entry is unruled, and an unruled item keeps the spec waiting for a person.

id.description: The item's id, copied unchanged from the items file.

ruling.description: spec-requirement-missing: the spec requires this and this candidate still lacks it. environmental: the agent could not do or check this where it ran, and nothing in the change is wrong because of that. out-of-scope: this candidate owes nothing more for it: the spec does not ask for it, another spec owns it, or it has since been done.
